name: Saroy Suites
tagline: Twelve rooms in an old house with a carved-plaster courtyard

listing.description: A website for a boutique hotel, guest house or serviced apartments. Sunlight through a carved lattice in WebGL, a booking bar with dates, rooms as a catalogue and a moments strip that drifts sideways.

seo.title: Saroy Suites — boutique hotel in central Tashkent
seo.description: Twelve rooms in a restored 1912 house: carved-plaster courtyard, breakfast by the fountain, hammam and terrace. A 10-minute walk to the Old City.
seo.answer: Saroy Suites is a 12-room boutique hotel in a restored 1912 house in central Tashkent. Rooms from 1,400,000 UZS per night with breakfast, check-in from 14:00, check-out by 12:00, airport transfer 250,000 UZS. Reception is open 24 hours.

sections.title: A house where time slows down
sections.subtitle: Twelve rooms around a carved-plaster courtyard with a fountain. Quiet, ten minutes from Chorsu bazaar.

sections.label: The house
sections.title: A merchant’s house we chose not to rebuild
sections.text: The house was built in 1912 for a family of silk merchants. We spent three years removing later partitions, cleaning the ganch and restoring the wooden ceilings by hand. What remains are tall windows, thick walls that keep the summer cool, and a courtyard every room opens onto. There is no lobby music here — just tea, books and the shade of the vine.

sections.label: Rooms
sections.title: Twelve rooms, no two alike
sections.intro: Price per night for two with breakfast. A baby cot and late check-out until 15:00 are free when the room is available.

items.title: Courtyard
items.text: Windows onto the courtyard, a carved niche above the bed, rain shower.

items.title: Silk
items.text: High painted ceilings, a bathtub by the window, a hand-embroidered suzani.

items.title: Aivan
items.text: A private covered veranda on the first floor overlooking the vine and minarets.

items.title: Merchant’s Suite
items.text: Two rooms, a sitting room with a fireplace and its own entrance from the courtyard.

items.name: Tandoor bread and kaymak
items.text: With Chimgan honey and quince jam

items.quote: We woke to the sound of the fountain and the smell of fresh bread. The first place in Tashkent where we didn’t want to go anywhere.
items.author: Anna & Mark

items.quote: Quiet as a village, yet Chorsu is a ten-minute walk. The staff remembered which tea I drink.
items.author: Dilnoza R.

items.q: What are check-in and check-out times?
items.a: Check-in from 14:00, check-out by 12:00. Early check-in and late check-out until 15:00 are free when the room is free.

items.q: How do I cancel a booking?
items.a: Free cancellation up to 3 days before arrival. After that we keep the cost of the first night.

sections.label: Booking
sections.title: When shall we expect you?
sections.text: Send your dates and number of guests — we reply within an hour and confirm the room.
